about: Areas for which Census withheld estimates, or told users to take care, because of a known data problem. The map shows these as withheld or cautioned, with the erratum, instead of as missing data. etl/build_geometry.py keeps their polygons although the cube has no row; the manifest carries this file to the app.

errata.title: Data Collection Error in Wyandanch CDP, New York and Brentwood CDP, New York
errata.summary: A problem in 2020 data collection (a limited number of computer-assisted personal interviews) across multiple topics. Census suppresses the 2019-2023 and 2020-2024 5-year products for both places and their nested geographies, and advises caution comparing 2016-2020, 2017-2021 and 2018-2022 5-year estimates there.
errata.how_derived: Tracts: the 14 Suffolk County 2020 tracts in the 2024 cartographic boundary file that are absent from Census's own 2020-2024 Geos file (Geos20245YR.txt); they do not overlap any other tract and together cover the two places.
